item.title: BMAD and Micrantha: Workflow Discipline on a Governed Substrate
item.description: A comparison of BMAD Method and Micrantha: similar execution mechanics, different control boundaries, and an unexpectedly clean composition that neither system was designed around.

item.title: From AI-Native SDLC to Governed Software Delivery
item.description: Why I see AI-native delivery as the macro lifecycle while traditional SDLC and product loops remain useful inside specialists—and where governed delivery adds stronger boundaries for evidence, authority, identity, and effects.
